stem: Maple Tickets receives event bursts for webhook processing, each run takes under 30 seconds, and traffic is idle overnight.

choices.text: AWS Fargate service with always-on tasks
Amazon ECS on EC2 capacity provider
AWS Lambda function triggered by events

rationale: Lambda aligns to short event-driven execution with pay-per-request and duration billing, reducing idle cost for overnight gaps. EC2 Auto Scaling and ECS on EC2 still require host fleet management and can leave idle baseline spend. Always-on Fargate services can work functionally, but they are less cost-efficient for this bursty, short-running pattern.
